items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: He played, kind of played the style of Fats Waller. They even called him Fats.

ctx.x: I mean you mentioned the Pichon. Oh yeah, Pichon, oh yes.

That was Walter. Walter, yes. Walter Pichon, he's one of the piano player. He's still going. Yeah, he came here, you know, he played here in St. Louis, he was up to town and country. He played down there's another very fine club in St. Louis over here on Washington Avenue. He came in and played for quite a long time. I forgot the name of that place. Anyway, he was a very fine piano player and I liked his style. He played, kind of played the style of Fats Waller. They even called him Fats. Yeah, that's right.…
Well did you play, you said you played mostly dance tunes, but did you play, you played some ragtime on the boat?
